instructions:
# Target
Implement T5 of the approved specification /home/opencode/projects/default/mcp-bridge/.omp/artifacts/binding-reinstatement/spec.md (sha256 97a416df9df4d1913292555ac8fe9636ecbea06d4524c6f6d01dce4b61d8bb40, revision r17). Repo /home/opencode/projects/default/mcp-bridge. HEAD fa832293. Work ONLY inside the 9 granted paths.

# Contract (follow spec sections 2-6 and 11 exactly)
R9: a configured server whose retained durable binding is retired is reinstated at admission (tombstone cleared, current configured endpoint fingerprint, no retired-era rows), with exactly one bounded warn record per reinstated server per committed admission.
Edits, exact:
1) internal/storage/reconcile.go: rewrite the retired re-add branch at :80-81 to clear Retired and set the current fingerprint for a CONFIGURED server (retirement removal + purge of that server's health/tool/embedding rows via purged[id]); update the doc comment :35-40; remove ErrRebindTombstoned (:13) and replace its use. Keep Validate, BindingAllowed, Binding.Retired JSON unchanged.
2) internal/service/reload.go: define the predicate pendingReinstatement(base) := base binding.Retired && configured && next !Retired (ADR2, NOT a fingerprint diff); hoist base := in.reconcileBase(previous) ABOVE :537; on a reinstatement admission purge stored prompt rows for each reinstated server after :681-683; persist the purged prompts BEFORE the snapshot persist inside commitMu with fail-closed nil-dependency handling for Persist, PersistPrompts (both modes) and LoadPrompts (startup only), the absolute load-error rule (only ErrNoSnapshot absorbed), and one internal_warning/prompt_persist warning on persist failure; skip EXACTLY :728-744 (next.snapshot = snapshot at :745 ALWAYS executes); emit one binding_reinstated warn per reinstated server AFTER :750 at commit point (after persistence and acceptance) behind the existing defensive conditions; NO refresh-mode guard, NO new AC.
3) internal/observe/log.go: add ONE eventMessage case for binding_reinstated (warn/degraded, operation in.mode.String(), server id only).
4) Tests: replace TestReconcileRejectsTombstonedRebind (:176-193) with TestReconcileReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer covering BOTH equal-fingerprint (incident shape) and distinct-fingerprint sub-cases; add TestReconcileReinstatementIsolatesSiblingServers, TestReconcileKeepsUnconfiguredTombstone (guard), TestReconcileReinstatesSchema1RetiredBinding; add the service tests named in the ledger (startup unbound equal-fp, cross-restart prompt purge, per-server emission incl. two-retired-server case, post-rename Persist failure survived-branch with REAL Store.Save then error, prompt-persist-failing drop then re-add, preservation guard); add the observe record-shape test and the docs containment test TestLoggingContractDocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants in cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go. Fixture discipline: explicitly SET a capturing Logger for every record-count assertion; explicitly override Persist for nil-Persist cases; set LoadPrompts/PersistPrompts explicitly (absent by default). Do NOT fake the not-survived post-rename branch.
5) docs/logging-contract.md: append the binding_reinstated row and the internal_warning variant rows AFTER the byte-identical :549 row, update :76 and :562-563. CHANGELOG.md: one entry.

# Acceptance / commands (all exit 0 at GREEN)
1) test "$(go test ./internal/storage -list 'TestReconcile|TestValidateRejects' | grep -cxE 'TestReconcile(ReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer|ReinstatementIsolatesSiblingServers|KeepsUnconfiguredTombstone|RebindsEndpointIdentityChange|ReinstatesSchema1RetiredBinding)|TestValidateRejectsBoundsAndIdentityConflicts')" = 6
2) go test ./internal/storage -run 'TestReconcileReinstatesConfiguredTombstonedServer|TestReconcileReinstatementIsolatesSiblingServers|TestReconcileKeepsUnconfiguredTombstone|TestReconcileRebindsEndpointIdentityChange|TestReconcileReinstatesSchema1RetiredBinding|TestValidateRejectsBoundsAndIdentityConflicts' -count=1
3) test "$(go test ./internal/service -list 'TestStartup|TestReloadReinstates' | grep -cxE 'TestStartup(ReinstatesConfiguredRetiredServerUnbound|ReinstatementDropsStalePromptRowsAcrossRestarts|ReinstatementEmitsExactlyOneWarnAtCommit|ReinstatementPostRenamePersistFailure|PreservesPromptsWithoutReinstatement|TombstonesAServerTheConfigDropped)|TestReloadReinstatesDroppedThenReaddedServer')" = 7
4) go test -race ./internal/service -run 'TestStartupReinstates|TestStartupReinstatement|TestStartupPreservesPrompts|TestReloadReinstates|TestStartupTombstonesAServerTheConfigDropped' -count=1
5) test "$(go test ./internal/observe -list 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape' | grep -cx 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape')" = 1; test "$(go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge -list 'TestLoggingContractR8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|TestLoggingContractDocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants' | grep -cxE 'TestLoggingContract(R8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|DocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants)')" = 2
6) go test ./internal/observe ./cmd/mcp-bridge -run 'TestBindingReinstatedEntryRecordShape|TestLoggingContractR8EventMessagesOperationsAndSchemaVersion|TestLoggingContractDocumentsBindingReinstatedAndWarningVariants' -count=1
7) go test -race -p 1 ./...
8) go run ./cmd/covcheck
9) go vet ./...
10) gofmt -l internal/storage/reconcile.go internal/storage/reconcile_test.go internal/service/reload.go internal/service/durable_test.go internal/observe/log.go internal/observe/log_test.go cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go  (exit 0 AND empty stdout)

# Report
Return STATUS (COMPLETE|BLOCKED), the exact files changed, RED-before/GREEN-after evidence per test, every command's exit status, and any deviation. Do not touch other files. If a contract test rejects beyond the named additions, report BLOCKED with the assertion.
